content: Aspire.Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL's AddNpgsqlDbContext registers a DbContextHealthCheck (calls EF Core CanConnectAsync) by default. Disabling requires DisableHealthChecks=true via appsettings (Aspire:Npgsql:EntityFrameworkCore:PostgreSQL section) or inline settings delegate. No opt-in needed — it is on unless explicitly disabled.
